newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria reaped $1.2 bln from oil products in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria reaped $1.2 bln from oil products in 1995.

text.p: Nigerian petroleum authorities said on Wednesday the country earned 99.5 billion naira ($1.24 billion) from the sale of refined oil products at home and abroad last year.

The annual report of the Pipelines and Products Marketing Company, a subsidiary of state-owned Nigerian Natonal Petroleum Corp (NNPC), said the income was from the sale of 8.947 million tonnes of oil products locally and the export of 1.646 million tonnes of petroleum products.
Domestic sales accounted for 88.919 billion naira while export sales brought in $120.53 million.
Nigeria produces about two million barrels per day of crude oil but has to import some products to meet local demand because of operational problems with its domestic refineries.
PPMC said local refineries processed a total of 10.18 million tonnes of crude oil as against 15.853 million tonnes planned for the period under review, representing a 64 percent performance.
It said because of the shortfall from local refineries 33 million barrels of crude oil was used for procurement from offshore of oil products, notably gasoline and base oils.
